caveats: DLF documents EMR on ECS Spark reaching v3 tables only by replacing the shipped component with a user-supplied open-source Iceberg >= 1.11.0 runtime (JDK 17, EMR-5.12.0+); that setup behaves like upstream Spark, not an Alibaba-supported EMR feature.
